author: GameTrailers
description:
Warning: This trailer contains flashing lights. 

Take a look at gameplay, combat, and foes you'll encounter from Descent of Lunaris in this new trailer for the upcoming dungeon-crawling game with a haunting sci-fi mystery. Descent of Lunaris will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Set in the year 2070, the demo kicks off after a lunar mining operation picks up a strange signal from deep within the moon. An experiment at a secret facility goes terribly wrong, with machines across the base turning violent and wiping out most of the crew.
title: Descent of Lunaris - Official Demo Trailer (Warning: Flashing Lights)

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Regions of Ruin: Runegate in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG hack-and-slash adventure. All that remains of the once-glorious dwarven civilization is dust, scattered exiles, and monster-infested landscapes in Regions of Ruin: Runegate. Venture on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure as a lone dwarf attempting to re-establish a haven for your dwarven kin - and delve into the mysteries of their forebears. Regions of Ruin: Runegate will be available on Steam and GOG on April 14, 2026.
title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest Dome Keeper trailer for the roguelike action miner game for another look at the multiplayer update. In Dome Keeper, dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed! Dome Keeper's free multiplayer update will be available on PC, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S on April 13, 2026.
title: Dome Keeper - Official Multiplayer Update Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Thysiastery, a turn-based dungeon-crawling roguelike RPG developed by Dirga. Players will lead a group into a sprawling labyrinth packed with enemies to dispatch. Master over 270 skills and fight over 80 different enemy types to secure a way out. Thysiastery is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Thysiastery - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Pluto is a roguelike deckbuilder where you cast elemental spells, outwit monstrous foes, and escape prison on your way to your niece’s birthday party. Pluto is available now on Steam.
title: Pluto - Official Launch Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter. Mistfall Hunter will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in summer 2026.
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Dominate the ultimate motor-sport ritual. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme tournament challenges. Out-score rivals alone or co-op to survive elimination, win the 1v1 final showdown, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Rise from "nobody" to arena champion. Monster Punk will be available on PC.
title: Monster Punk - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy. No Wings Required will be available on PC via Steam.
title: No Wings Required - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running. Get deep dive into Terrible Lizards in this latest trailer for the upcoming game. Terrible Lizards will be available on PC in summer 2026.
title: Terrible Lizards - Official Overview Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! Get another look SoulQuest in this trailer for the upcoming action game featuring Celtic mythology. SoulQuest will be available on PC in April 2026.
title: SoulQuest - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at gameplay from Scramble Knights Royale in this new trailer for the upcoming fantasy battle royale game. Embark on a classic top-down adventure together with friends. Fight monsters, complete quests, and conquer dungeons—all while brawling it out with 32 players in strategic and chaotic combat. Be the last knight standing to win! A Duos Playtest for Scramble Knights Royale runs on Steam from today, March 9, to March 12, 2026.
title: Scramble Knights Royale - Official Duos Playtest Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Barkour is a fast-paced stealth-action platformer where you play as Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging canine with a knack for parkour, gadgets and barking at villains. Join a secret organization to stop evil schemes in a world full of charming absurdity. Barkour will be available on PC, and a new demo is out now on Steam.
title: Barkour - Official New Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: The Player Who Can't Level Up is an action roguelite game based on web novels and webtoons of the same name. You can freely combine various combat styles and numerous growth factors to become stronger. Experience unexpected enhancement effects through various random elements. The Player Who Can't Level Up will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Stove, Xbox, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). A demo will be out in April 2026.
title: The Player Who Can't Level Up - Official Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville trailer for this upcoming murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else. Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville will be available on PC on April 14, 2026.
title: Moses & Plato - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure. Watch the Echo Generation 2 gameplay trailer for this upcoming sequel. Echo Generation 2 will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox on PC in 2026. The demo is out now.
title: Echo Generation 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Moonsigil Atlas, a strategy deckbuilding roguelike developed by Snake Tower Games. Players will engage with a cosmic-styled deckbuilding experience, where space is the prime factor rather than energy. 

Place sigil-cards onto a moon-tile board, then build power through adjacency, overlap, and precise positioning to cast the card. Moonsigil Atlas is launching in June 2026 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now.

#MoonsigilAtlas #Deckbuilder
title: Moonsigil Atlas - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Xenonauts 2 gets a new trailer and the version 1.0 release date announcement. Watch the latest Xenonauts 2 trailer for this turn-based strategy game to see gameplay and more. Version 1.0 of Xenonauts 2 will be available on PC (Epic Games Store, GOG, and Steam) on April 2, 2026.

Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.
title: Xenonauts 2 - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for Epione Spes in Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy. A keen mind and master of diagnosis, Epione joins the party in Dark Heresy. 

Join Epione in Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

#Warhammer40k #Warhammer
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy - Official Epione Spes Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Kritter: Defend Together, a chaotic co-op action roguelite game developed by LJF Games. Players will defend a base with up to four players from run to run. Explore the planet to find resources, provide sufficient defensive measures, and escape. Kritter: Defend Together is launching on March 10 for PC (Steam).
title: Kritter: Defend Together - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Handmancers in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person Rock-Paper-Scissors roguelite deckbuilder. In Handmancers, every encounter is a tactical mind game and every run is built around shaping your hand into something devastating. Beneath the simple ruleset is a deep customization layer: Gems reshape Signs with new effects, while Artifacts unlock synergies that can radically change how fights unfold. It’s not just about picking the right Sign, it’s about building the perfect hand to outsmart and overpower whatever waits ahead. Handmancers will now be available in Steam Early Access on May 5, 2026.
title: Handmancers - Official New Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Walker, a co-op survival horror game developed by Dadilip. Players will cooperate with their crew to survive inside a huge Walker to protect it from any and all threats. 

Make use of a suite of items, the environment itself, and more to hunt monsters in the darkness. Walker is available now for PC (Steam).

#Walker #CoopGame
title: Walker - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Crypt Keeper trailer to see what to expect with the Essence-ial update, which brings a powerful new system that gives you more control over how they shape the battlefield. 

This new update adds Essence, a new strategic resource that allows you to strengthen your undead forces and weaken incoming enemy waves before they even reach your defenses. The update also adds the new Ossuary building, the Forge building, the new enemy spawner manipulation strategic option, and quality of life improvements. 

Crypt Keeper's Essence-ial update is available now.
title: Crypt Keeper - Official Essence-ial Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Accolades Trailer for Styx: Blades of Greed, a single-player action-adventure stealth game developed by Cyanide Studio. 

Players will harness the power of Quartz to explore vertical environments, make use of new tools, and attack from the shadows to master the art of stealth. 

Take a look at the latest trailer to garner the critical reception behind Styx: Blades of Greed, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#Styx #StealthGames
title: Styx: Blades of Greed - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Forge a mighty realm from the ashes in Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin. Check out the Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin launch trailer. In Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin, journey into the Withered Worlds and explore devastated landscapes. Rise of Ruin features a new culture, form, wildlife and magical tomes, as well as new environmental challenges and locations to conquer and explore. Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin is available now as part of Expansion Pass 3.
title: Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Help young adventurer Adol Christin regain his lost memories when Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta launches on Nintendo Switch on April 28, 2026. Watch the latest Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta trailer for this classic action-RPG, which features a rearranged musical score.
title: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at Capy Castaway in this latest trailer for the upcoming cozy exploration adventure game where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. 

Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home. Capy Castaway will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

#CapyCastaway #Adventure
title: Capy Castaway - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu to see gameplay and cosmic horrors from this upcoming co-op action-horror adventure game. The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu will be available on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on July 15, 2026.

In The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, you and your companions are on the deck of your galleon. El Capitán has given you a contract to fulfill: gather as much wealth as possible, find a missing person, locate an ancient fort, and, if possible, return safe and sound from this perilous expedition. As soon as you set foot on the shore, at the edge of the jungle, a vague sense of dread takes hold. In this jungle, treasures and mysteries await you, but so do unspeakable entities ready to make you regret ever setting foot in their territory.

#TheMound #Cthulhu
title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Update 1.3 Overview Trailer for Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch, a turn-based tactical roguelite RPG developed by Ocean Drive Studio. Players will access a suite of new features with the latest update, packed with fast-paced Quick Expeditions, a new arena to battle in, and expanded difficulty options. 

Update 1.3 for Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

#LostEidolons #RPG
title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch - Official Update 1.3 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Yuming Character Trailer for Duet Night Abyss, a free-to-play, anime, narrative-driven looter shooter RPG developed by Pan Studio. 

Players can get familiar with Yuming, a formidable warrior armed with a bladed staff weapon called the Venial Sinscales. Witness Yuming slice the opposition in Duet Night Abyss on March 10 for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Duet Night Abyss - Official Yuming Character Trailer
